pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large polygonal dark regions with sharp pixel-level edge gradients transitioning to light corridors. Geometry is predominantly quadrilateral and pentagonal with high spatial density across the visible flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-valent and quadri-valent. Pixel thickness is narrow and relatively uniform, forming a high-contrast topological grid.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile along the dorsal neck line, creating a fine-grained jagged silhouette against the background.
